CORE_PHRASES.a_look_in_room: OK, I will look in the {room}.
CORE_PHRASES.iss_object: the {what} is not in my plan
CORE_PHRASES.iss_place: the {what} you mentioned is not in my plan
CORE_PHRASES.q_coverage: You also asked me for this, but I have not done it: {what}. Should I do it now?
CORE_PHRASES.q_mentioned: You mentioned the {what}. What should I do there?
CORE_PHRASES.q_place_unknown: I could not find '{said}' on my map. Do you mean: {options}? Or tell me another place.
CORE_PHRASES.q_repeat: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?
CORE_PHRASES.q_unclear_task: Sorry, I did not understand. Could you say the task in other words?
CORE_PHRASES.q_where_bring: Where are you? Or where should I put it?
CORE_PHRASES.q_where_in_home: Which room, or which piece of furniture, is it in?
CORE_PHRASES.q_where_is: I couldn't find the {object}. Where is it?
CORE_PHRASES.q_where_is_here: I don't see the {object} here. Where is it?
CORE_PHRASES.q_which_known: I know of more than one {object}: {text}. Which one do you mean?
CORE_PHRASES.q_which_one: I see more than one {object} here: {text}. Which one do you mean?
CORE_PHRASES.q_which_part: Which part is not right: what I take, where I put it, or who it is for?
CORE_PHRASES.q_which_reading: I can read that two ways: I will {first}, or I will {second}. Which one do you mean?
CORE_PHRASES.rb_on_from: put the {object} from the {source} on the {place}
CORE_PHRASES.rb_on_near_person: bring the {object} to {person} and put it on the {place} next to them
CORE_PHRASES.rb_on_near_you: bring you the {object} and put it on the {place} next to you
CORE_PHRASES.rb_restated: I understood it the same way again.
CORE_PHRASES.rb_unsure: I am not sure I understood ({issues}).
CORE_PHRASES.say_could_not_do: Sorry, I could not finish the task.
CORE_PHRASES.say_gave_up: I am sorry, I still could not understand what you want me to do.
CORE_PHRASES.say_no_answer: I did not hear an answer, so I will stop here.
CORE_PHRASES.say_not_confirmed: I could not confirm with you what to do, so I will stop here.
CORE_PHRASES.say_untranslated: Sorry, I cannot say that in your language right now.

HELP_MOVE: Is something in the way? Please clear the way and say yes.
HELP_PICK: Could you move it closer to the edge, then say yes?
